en: Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing an inner courtyard with arcades, balustrades and a domed stair-tower of a Renaissance-style building. Around the top border are various heraldic shields. At the bottom are two smaller vignettes: one of a street scene with historic buildings, and two groups of three figures in old-fashioned dress holding banners. One banner reads "LANDHAUS" and the other includes the word "GRAZ". Text at the very bottom notes the artist and location.
